question: Newton is the unit to measure ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** Force.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the International System of Units, the unit of **force is the newton**. It is described as the force that accelerates a mass of one kilogramme by** one metre per second per second, or 1 kg m/s2.**
 
• **F=ma, or force is equal to mass times acceleration**, is the second of Newton's laws of motion.
 
• Force is the push or pull that an item experiences that result in a **change in velocity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__​**

 
• The amount of force applied to a certain region is referred to as** pressure**. Therefore, you can either apply a large force or a force over a limited region to create a **large amount of pressure.**
 
• The quantity of energy moved or converted per unit of time is** known as power.**
 
• The obstruction to current flow in an electrical circuit is** measured by resistance. **
